headline: mrkmakr and Burton Lancaster surge into ARC-2 top 33

sections.text: mrkmakr gained 6.95 to 36.67, leaping from 1135th to 29th. Burton Lancaster gained 6.11 to 35.83, rising from 1162nd to 33rd.
Both now sit among the board's top 33 on a field of 2,783 teams, turning long climbs into a fresh contest near the front.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
